corePassives.description: Whenever Urahara releases his special attack, technique, Ultimate, or counterattack, grants 1 stack of Reishi Analysis to the team. Each stack increases the team's ATK by 10% for 25 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
corePassives.name: Reishi Analysis

corePassives.description: Urahara gains an extra 100% Spiritual Pressure when releasing a technique.
corePassives.name: Battlefield Observation

corePassives.description: Urahara's Ultimate Energy Charge Rate increases by 20%.
corePassives.name: Kido Master

corePassives.description: Whenever Urahara releases a special attack, increases the next Ultimate DMG by 20%, stacking up to 4 times.
corePassives.name: Spiritual Power Up

name: Kisuke Urahara

rotations.name: Technique Setup
rotations.notes: His Ult DMG passive only affects himself
steps: Swap back on cooldown to refresh

skills.description:
Urahara wields Benihime to strike 5 times, dealing damage equal to 180% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. ~~Cry Out! Benihime!~~ At Max Spiritual Pressure, press and hold basic attack 
 Urahara releases a long-ranged sword wave, dealing damage equal to 425% of ATK. 
 For special attacks, reserves once at Max Spiritual Pressure.
skills.name: Awaken, Benihime

skills.description: Urahara throws a Portable Giga forward and immediately falls back, gaining a stack of Spiritual Pressure Reserve. The Portable Giga taunts nearby enemies within a large area and explodes in 6s, dealing damage equal to 237.5% of ATK.
skills.name: Portable Gigai

skills.description: Urahara fires a Spiritual Bullet at the enemy, dealing DMG equal to 750% of ATK. The team's Crit DMG then increases by a fixed 50% + 50% of Urahara's Crit DMG for 25s.
skills.name: Hado Number 91: Senjukotentaiho

skills.description: Urahara releases Spiritual Pressure in the form of a net from Benihime's blade, which restrains the enemy and explodes, dealing damage equal to 625% of ATK, immediately raising his Spiritual Pressure to the maximum, and gaining 1 stack of Reishi Analysis.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Urahara gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step

rationale: If Kisuke is the only support on your team, Kenpachi stamp set is better for him. If used in a double support team, then Kisuke's own set is superior. The differences are small though. Pick whichever set has the best substats and passives.
